title: GIRDER ROAD ARROW
notes: Separate ROAD-section ARROW page (image uploads dated January 2025) lists ¥14,800; sizes S (476 mm), M (503 mm), L (533 mm); T700+T800 aero frame and fork, EPS molding, internal routing, press-fit bottom bracket with an in-house ceramic-bearing BB described as 'PF386 to T47 tool compatible', 12 mm thru-axles; T700+T800 integrated bar; Shimano 105 R7170 Di2 2×12, FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm, CS-R7100 11-36T, CN-M7100, R7170 hydraulic discs; Selle Italia saddle and tape; Adler Augen wavy-rim ceramic-bearing wheels 50 mm front / 60 mm rear; Maxxis 700C×28C with TPU tubes; weight 9.1 kg (basis not stated). The page's geometry image did not load on access. Frame material, BB and size labels differ from the NEW 2025 ARROW page, so the two are treated as separate generations.
